title: Track, Articulate, Act: Generating Articulation from Casual Human Videos
abstract: Human videos contain rich causal evidence for robot manipulation: they reveal how hand motion induces object motion and produces task-relevant changes in object state. In this work, we study articulated objects such as doors, drawers, cabinets, laptops, ovens, and hinged containers that are ubiquitous in daily life and present unique challenges for embodied interaction. These objects cannot be represented by a single pose; their motion depends on the underlying parts and joints. We introduce a real-to-sim framework that reconstructs a simulation-ready articulated object and hand-object interaction from a casual monocular RGB video, without RGB-D or multi-view input, prior scans, manually specified joints, or robot demonstrations. Our key insight is that dense 3D point tracks provide an embodiment-agnostic articulation cue: points on the fixed link remain approximately stationary, while points on the moving link follow coherent revolute or prismatic motion. Our method segments the links, estimates the joint and its state trajectory, reconstructs an articulated asset, and aligns the recovered 3D hand motion with the object. Central to our approach is a modular recipe that repurposes powerful pretrained models for single-image 3D reconstruction, mesh segmentation, and 3D scene flow, connecting their predictions through explicit geometric reasoning to infer articulation. We use the reconstructed articulated object and the human hand trajectory to replay interactions through contact in MuJoCo. The framework shows how pretrained vision models and explicit motion reasoning can turn casual human videos into articulated object models suitable for downstream embodied interactions. https://track-articulate-act.github.io/
tldr: 提出从单目随手视频重建仿真就绪铰接物体与手物交互的 real-to-sim 框架。
motivation: 门、抽屉、橱柜等铰接物体在日常生活中无处不在，但其运动依赖内部部件和关节，无法用单一物体位姿表示，给具身交互带来独特挑战。研究旨在仅凭普通单目 RGB 人类视频，在无需 RGB-D、多视角、先验扫描、手工关节定义或机器人演示的条件下，获取可用于机器人操作的铰接结构与手物交互证据。
method: 核心洞察是密集 3D 点轨迹提供与具身无关的铰接线索：固定连杆上的点近似静止，运动连杆上的点呈现一致的旋转或平移运动。方法据此分割连杆、估计关节及其状态轨迹、重建铰接资产，并将恢复的 3D 手部运动与物体对齐；同时采用模块化方案复用单图像 3D 重建、网格分割和 3D 场景流等预训练模型，通过显式几何推理连接预测，并在 MuJoCo 中利用重建物体与手部轨迹进行接触重放。
result: 摘要未提供定量指标；实验上在 MuJoCo 中利用重建的铰接物体与手部轨迹进行接触重放，展示了从单目随手 RGB 视频生成仿真就绪铰接物体与手物交互的可行性。
conclusion: 该工作表明预训练视觉模型与显式运动推理可将随手人类视频转化为铰接物体模型，为下游具身交互和机器人操作提供 real-to-sim 资产生成途径。

title: NormLift: From Lifted Features To Semantic Reliability In 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Training-free weighted aggregation is widely used to lift 2D semantic features onto 3D Gaussians for open-vocabulary scene understanding, yet its theoretical role remains insufficiently understood. Existing analyses typically justify this operation from the rendering side, treating Gaussian features as linearly composable Euclidean variables for reconstructing 2D feature maps. However, this view does not match downstream 3D usage, where each Gaussian is often queried independently in a cosine-based embedding space. We revisit feature lifting from the 3D side and formulate per-Gaussian assignment as a cosine alignment problem on the CLIP unit sphere. Under this objective, the L2-normalized semantic back-projected feature emerges as the closed-form solution, providing a complementary interpretation of the standard lifting rule from the perspective of per-Gaussian semantic assignment. The same formulation further yields a norm decomposition into intra-view and inter-view consistency, suggesting that feature magnitude itself can serve as a semantic reliability signal. Calibrated by effective multi-view support, this reliability score guides a mode-voting refinement that preserves CLIP feature validity by avoiding linear averaging. Experiments on open-vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation show that NormLift is an efficient, training-free framework that achieves strong performance across evaluation protocols.
tldr: NormLift 从余弦对齐视角重释 3D 高斯特征提升，用特征模长作语义可靠性信号实现免训练开放词汇分割。
motivation: 免训练加权聚合被广泛用于把 2D 语义特征提升到 3D 高斯上，但其理论作用尚不清晰。现有分析多从渲染侧出发，把高斯特征当作可线性组合的欧氏变量以重建 2D 特征图，这与下游在余弦嵌入空间中逐高斯独立查询的 3D 用法不符。
method: 从 3D 侧重新审视特征提升，把每个高斯的特征分配形式化为 CLIP 单位球面上的余弦对齐问题，推导出 L2 归一化语义反投影特征是闭式解，从而给出标准提升规则的互补解释。该形式化还给出模长的 intra-view 与 inter-view 一致性分解，说明特征幅值本身可作为语义可靠性信号；经有效多视图支持校准后，该可靠性分数驱动 mode-voting 精炼，通过避免线性平均来保持 CLIP 特征的有效性。
result: 开放词汇 3D 语义分割实验表明，NormLift 是高效、免训练的框架，在多种评测协议下均取得强劲性能（摘要未给出具体量化指标）。
conclusion: 该工作为特征提升规则提供了基于逐高斯语义分配的新解释，并把特征模长转化为可校准的语义可靠性度量，进而形成免训练、高效的开放词汇 3D 场景理解方案，对 3D 高斯表示下的语义理解具有潜在影响。

title: Geometry beneath the Waves: Dense Priors for Sparse-View Underwater 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Underwater 3D reconstruction supports applications ranging from marine ecosystem monitoring and subsea inspection to underwater archaeology, education, and immersive visualisation. 3D Gaussian Splatting has made real-time photorealistic novel-view rendering practical, while underwater variants incorporate physically based image-formation models to separate medium effects from scene radiance. Their reconstruction quality, however, remains fundamentally limited by the geometry used for initialisation.
tldr: 针对稀疏视角水下3DGS因初始化几何不佳导致重建质量受限的问题，提出基于稠密先验的改进方法。
motivation: 水下3D重建可用于海洋生态监测、水下检测、考古、教育与沉浸式可视化；3DGS已实现实时逼真新视角渲染，水下变体通过基于物理的图像形成模型分离介质效应与场景辐射，但重建质量受初始化几何的根本限制。
method: 标题提示采用稠密先验（Dense Priors）服务于稀疏视角水下3DGS的几何初始化，但摘要未给出具体技术路线与网络设计。

title: CADSplat: Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting Aided by CAD Models for Robust, Photorealistic Digital-Twin Reconstruction
abstract: We present CADSplat, a framework that reconstructs photorealistic, geometrically accurate digital twins from sparse ($<15$ views), wide-baseline posed images of an object by regularizing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) with an explicit CAD shape prior. Using such a prior requires finding a CAD model whose shape resembles the object depicted in the images and determining the pose of each camera relative to the object. We obtain both by matching segmented object silhouettes against silhouettes rendered from a CAD library and keeping the camera-to-object poses of the best-matching model. We then anchor 3D Gaussian primitives to the surface of the retrieved model and jointly optimize the 3DGS parameters, the camera-to-object registration, and a non-rigid deformation field to account for shape differences between the physical object and the CAD model. Across two real-world datasets, CADSplat outperforms unconstrained, few-shot, and mesh-texturing baselines and degrades gracefully to as few as 3 views. Our experiments show that most of the gain in rendering quality comes from how the splats are constrained---a fixed set of splats tied to a surface and moved by a single smooth deformation field---rather than from the CAD shape itself. The CAD model adds shape knowledge where views are scarcest, in the sparsest captures and on strongly self-occluded objects, and it places every camera in the object's own frame. This enables applications beyond novel-view synthesis, such as markerless augmented reality registration, per-image object pose estimation, physical simulations, and the transfer of part labels from the design to the reconstruction.
tldr: CADSplat 用 CAD 形状先验约束 3D 高斯，从少于 15 个稀疏视角重建逼真数字孪生模型。
motivation: 稀疏视角（少于 15 张）、大基线的物体图像难以支撑传统 3DGS 重建，容易出现过拟合与几何失真，而现有少样本方法缺乏显式形状约束。作者希望借助 CAD 模型这一显式形状先验，同时解决重建质量与相机—物体位姿标定两个问题。
method: 先对图像做物体分割，将轮廓与 CAD 库中模型渲染的轮廓进行匹配，取最佳匹配模型的相机—物体位姿作为初值；随后把 3D 高斯图元锚定在检索到的 CAD 表面上，联合优化高斯参数、相机—物体配准以及一个非刚性形变场，以补偿实物与 CAD 模型之间的形状差异。
result: 在两个真实数据集上，CADSplat 优于无约束、少样本和网格纹理化等基线，并在仅 3 个视角时仍能优雅退化。消融表明渲染质量的大部分提升来自高斯的约束方式（固定在表面、由单一平滑形变场驱动），而非 CAD 形状本身；CAD 先验在视角最少和自遮挡严重的物体上补充形状知识。
conclusion: 该工作证明显式 CAD 先验可有效正则化稀疏视角 3DGS 并同时给出物体坐标系下的相机位姿，其贡献更多在于高斯的表面锚定与平滑形变设计。除新视角合成外，该框架还支持无标记增强现实配准、逐图像物体位姿估计、物理仿真以及将设计中的部件标签迁移到重建结果上。

title: GeoCond: A Conditioning-Aware Reliability Adapter for Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Feed-forward 3D foundation models such as VGGT predict cameras, depth, and point maps in a single pass, but can fail silently under low overlap, low parallax, and extreme relative rotation. Stratified analyses over these factors show that these failures are governed by geometric conditioning and are poorly captured by native aleatoric confidence. We introduce GeoCond, a lightweight reliability adapter for frozen feed-forward 3D backbones. GeoCond reads the backbone's predicted geometry and outputs pose-level uncertainty and a refinement gate. During training, it can be supervised by frame-permutation orbit variance, ground-truth pose error when labels are available, or cycle residuals from unlabelled independent pose graphs. At inference, the default head requires only one backbone pass and a small MLP. On VGGT, GeoCond improves out-of-distribution (OOD) AUSE (area under the sparsification-error curve; lower is better) from $0.32$ to $0.20$ over native confidence, transfers zero-shot to outdoor extreme-view scenes, and avoids the collapse caused by applying bundle adjustment uniformly. Across multiple backbones, cycle-distilled variants provide a ground-truth-free adaptation route, including cases where permutation variance vanishes on equivariant models. The same reliability signal supports gated refinement, pose-graph weighting, calibration, curation, and capture decisions. Reliable feed-forward 3D reconstruction requires not only predicting geometry, but also knowing when that geometry should be trusted.
tldr: GeoCond为冻结前馈3D骨干提供轻量可靠性适配，通过几何条件预测位姿不确定性并提升OOD可靠性。
motivation: 前馈3D基础模型如VGGT能单次预测相机、深度和点图，但在低重叠、低视差和极端相对旋转下会静默失败。分层分析表明这些失败由几何条件主导，而原生偶然不确定性难以捕捉。
method: GeoCond是面向冻结前馈3D骨干的轻量可靠性适配器，读取骨干预测几何并输出位姿级不确定性与细化门控。训练可由帧置换轨道方差、有标签真值位姿误差或无标签独立位姿图循环残差监督；推理默认仅需一次骨干前向和小型MLP。
result: 在VGGT上，GeoCond将OOD AUSE从0.32降至0.20，优于原生置信度，零样本迁移至户外极端视角场景，并避免统一应用BA导致的崩溃。跨多个骨干，循环蒸馏变体提供无真值适配路径，包括等变模型上置换方差消失的情况。
conclusion: 同一可靠性信号支持门控细化、位姿图加权、校准、筛选和采集决策。可靠的前馈3D重建不仅需要预测几何，还需要判断何时应信任该几何。

title: Prosthesis-Aware 3D Human Pose Estimation: A Dataset and Benchmark for RSP Users
abstract: Recovering 3D human body motion from video is important for applications such as rehabilitation assessment and sports performance evaluation. For prosthesis users, this requires capturing both natural body joints and the geometry of the prosthetic device, a challenge that existing methods are not designed to address. Model-based estimators rely on body models trained on non-amputee individuals and cannot represent prosthesis geometry, while model-free methods lack body kinematic priors and are unreliable under occlusion. This challenge is particularly prominent for users of running-specific prostheses (RSPs), where the RSP has a complex curved geometry and moves dynamically during exercise. To fill this gap, we collect RSP3D, the first 3D dataset of RSP users, covering essential daily-life and exercise actions from participants with varied amputation conditions, using a multi-camera marker-based motion capture setup. We formally define the task of prosthesis-aware 3D pose estimation, evaluate representative methods in a zero-shot setting, and confirm their individual limitations. We further propose a hybrid baseline combining model-based body joint estimation with model-free RSP shape recovery, establishing a starting point for future research.
tldr: 提出首个RSP用户3D数据集RSP3D，定义假肢感知3D姿态估计任务并建立混合基线。
motivation: 从视频恢复3D人体运动对康复评估和运动表现分析很重要，但假肢用户需同时捕捉自然关节与假肢几何。现有基于模型方法依赖非截肢者人体模型，无法表示假肢；无模型方法缺乏运动学先验且在遮挡下不可靠，RSP用户因假肢曲率复杂、动态运动而问题突出。
method: 构建RSP3D：首个RSP用户3D数据集，采用多相机标记点运动捕捉，覆盖不同截肢情况的日常生活与运动动作。正式定义假肢感知3D姿态估计任务，在零样本设置下评测代表性方法，并提出结合基于模型身体关节估计与无模型RSP形状恢复的混合基线。
result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标；零样本评测确认代表性方法各自局限，混合基线作为未来研究的起点。
conclusion: 贡献首个RSP用户3D数据集、任务定义与基准，并给出可行混合基线，有望推动假肢用户康复评估与运动分析中的3D姿态估计研究。

title: PanoGS-SLAM: Panoramic 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM
abstract: Real-time dense SLAM is a core capability for robotics applications that require robust localization and high- quality mapping in dynamic or fast-changing environments. Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based SLAM methods have shown promising performance, but most are designed for narrow-FoV pinhole cameras, where limited angular coverage weakens pose observability and often leads to unstable photo- metric optimization under rapid motion and large viewpoint changes. We present PanoGS-SLAM, the first panoramic dense SLAM system built on 3D Gaussian Splatting. Our method per- forms differentiable rendering and pose optimization directly in the spherical domain, enabling omnidirectional photometric constraints for more stable tracking. To improve geometric consistency and robustness, we introduce (1) a sphere-consistent photometric loss that compensates for the area distortion of equirectangular projection, and (2) a depth-guided Gaussian initialization strategy that stabilizes incremental mapping in newly observed regions. Extensive experiments on both real and synthetic panoramic benchmarks (PALVIO and SynPano) show that PanoGS-SLAM consistently outperforms geometric and GS-based baselines in tracking accuracy and rendering quality, while achieving fast front-end convergence and real-time perfor- mance. In addition, controlled field-of-view experiments reveal a clear monotonic improvement in optimization conditioning and convergence stability as angular coverage increases, high- lighting the fundamental role of sensing geometry in shaping the optimization landscape of differentiable Gaussian-based SLAM. The source code will be made publicly available.
tldr: 首个基于3D高斯泼溅的全景稠密SLAM系统，通过球面域可微渲染与深度引导初始化提升跟踪精度和实时建图质量。
motivation: 现有3DGS-SLAM方法多面向窄视场针孔相机，角覆盖有限导致位姿可观测性弱，在快速运动和大视角变化下光度优化不稳定。该工作旨在构建全景稠密SLAM，利用全向感知提升跟踪鲁棒性与建图质量。
method: PanoGS-SLAM在球面域直接进行可微渲染与位姿优化，获得全向光度约束以稳定跟踪。方法引入球面一致性光度损失来补偿等距柱状投影的面积畸变，并采用深度引导高斯初始化策略稳定新观测区域的增量建图。
result: 在真实与合成全景基准PALVIO和SynPano上，PanoGS-SLAM在跟踪精度和渲染质量上持续优于几何与GS基线，并实现前端快速收敛和实时性能。受控视场实验表明，随着角覆盖增大，优化条件与收敛稳定性呈清晰单调提升。
conclusion: 该工作提出首个基于3DGS的全景稠密SLAM系统，证明全景感知几何能显著改善可微高斯SLAM的优化景观，并为机器人在动态大视角环境中的鲁棒定位与高质量建图提供新方案。源代码将公开。

title: DecoGS: Adaptive Static-Dynamic Decoupling of 3D Gaussians for Free-Viewpoint Video Streaming
abstract: Streaming 3D reconstruction demands both speed and temporal fidelity, goals that existing methods undermine by updating every Gaussian every frame, even in static regions. We present DecoGS, a method for efficient online training of 3D Gaussians from streaming videos. Unlike prior methods that update the entire scene indiscriminately, DecoGS introduces an adaptive mechanism that selectively focuses optimization on spatiotemporal regions exhibiting motion or photometric changes. This targeted training strategy eliminates redundant updates that cause flickering and drift in nominally static regions, while enabling fast, high-fidelity scene updates. The pipeline further integrates region-aware Gaussian management through gradient gating and efficient visibility filtering to maintain temporal coherence and a compact memory footprint. On N3DV and MeetRoom, DecoGS achieves 34.55 and 31.60 dB PSNR respectively, outperforming all streaming and offline baselines, while rendering at 261 FPS with $70\times$ lower temporal flicker than the best prior method, requiring no large-scale pretraining.
tldr: DecoGS通过自适应静动态解耦与区域感知管理，实现高效低闪烁的自由视点视频流式重建。
motivation: 现有流式3D重建方法每帧更新所有高斯，导致静态区域冗余更新、闪烁和漂移，难以兼顾速度与时间保真。DecoGS旨在仅优化运动或光度变化的时空区域，以解决这一矛盾。
method: 提出自适应机制，选择性优化存在运动或光度变化的时空区域，消除静态区域冗余更新。结合梯度门控的区域感知高斯管理与高效可见性过滤，保持时序一致性和紧凑内存，并支持无需大规模预训练的在线训练。
result: 在N3DV和MeetRoom上PSNR分别达34.55和31.60 dB，超过所有流式与离线基线。渲染速度261 FPS，时间闪烁比最佳先前方法低70倍，且无需大规模预训练。
conclusion: DecoGS证明静动态解耦与区域感知更新可同时提升流式自由视点视频的重建质量、速度和时序稳定性。为在线3D高斯流媒体提供了高效且可扩展的解决方案。

title: HuMemSLAM: Efficient Human-Inspired Semantic Place Recognition for Robust Visual SLAM
abstract: Autonomous systems require reliable place recognition for efficient and effective simultaneous localisation and mapping (SLAM). Traditional geometric visual SLAM approaches rely on low-level features and geometric consistency, but remain vulnerable to perceptual aliasing, where different places appear similar, and perceptual variation, where the same place appears different. Although semantic SLAM and modern learned visual place recognition (VPR) methods improve robustness under challenging perceptual conditions, real-time deployment requires both high retrieval accuracy and low latency. Inspired by human memory and perception, we propose HuMem-VPR, which exploits the bidirectional relationship between bottom-up perceptual evidence and top-down contextual reasoning to achieve high-level place understanding. We further introduce HuMemSLAM, the integration of HuMem-VPR with ORB-SLAM3. HuMem VPR achieved the highest aggregate retrieval accuracy on the real-image benchmark, competitive accuracy on the CARLA benchmark, and approximately two to three times lower latency than the evaluated state-of-the-art VPR methods. Across the evaluated dataset families and online experiments, HuMemSLAM substantially improved integrated Recall @1 over ORB-SLAM3's native retrieval while reducing the proposals submitted to its geometric backend.
tldr: 提出人类记忆启发的HuMem-VPR并集成到ORB-SLAM3，提升语义地点识别精度与实时性。
motivation: 传统几何视觉SLAM依赖低层特征与几何一致性，易受感知混叠和感知变化影响。语义SLAM与学习式视觉地点识别虽提升鲁棒性，但实时部署仍需高检索精度与低延迟。
method: 受人类记忆与感知启发，提出HuMem-VPR，利用自下而上感知证据与自上而下上下文推理的双向关系实现高层地点理解。进一步将其与ORB-SLAM3集成，形成HuMemSLAM。
result: HuMem-VPR在真实图像基准上取得最高综合检索精度，在CARLA基准上具备竞争力，且延迟比评估的SOTA VPR方法低约2至3倍。在多个数据集族和在线实验中，HuMemSLAM相较ORB-SLAM3原生检索显著提升集成Recall@1，同时减少提交给几何后端的候选数量。
conclusion: 结果表明，人类记忆启发的语义地点识别可在精度与效率间取得良好平衡，并增强ORB-SLAM3在挑战性感知条件下的鲁棒性。该方法为实时语义SLAM中的地点识别与后端负载降低提供了有效方案。

title: Bi-FlowGS: Bridging Generative View Completion and Gaussian Geometry through Bidirectional Flow Co-Refinement
abstract: Sparse-view 3D scene reconstruction with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is inherently underconstrained. Plausible renderings can also coexist with erroneous Gaussian geometry, as errors in positions or depths may be concealed by opacity, scale, and appearance; we term this failure mode Geometry Cheating. Existing regularization methods constrain geometry but remain limited to observed views, while video-diffusion-based methods complete unseen views yet mainly use them as RGB pseudo-supervision, underusing motion and temporal priors and lacking explicit geometry supervision. We present Bi-FlowGS, which uses optical flow to bridge generative view completion and Gaussian geometry regularization. Our plug-and-play Video-to-Geometry Flow Distillation (V2G) distills temporal correspondence priors from restored videos into Gaussian geometry to alleviate Geometry Cheating. Conversely, Geometry-to-Video Flow-Guided Restoration (G2V) uses the current 3DGS geometry to guide temporally consistent video restoration, providing more reliable generative supervision. Together, V2G and G2V form an implicit bidirectional co-refinement process, enabling restored videos and the optimized 3DGS scene to iteratively improve each other. Experiments demonstrate improved rendering quality and geometric consistency across wide-baseline and unbounded 360° benchmarks.
tldr: Bi-FlowGS 用光流桥接生成式视角补全与 3DGS 几何，通过双向流协同精炼缓解稀疏视角下的几何作弊。
motivation: 稀疏视角 3DGS 重建本质欠约束，常出现 Geometry Cheating：错误的位置或深度几何被不透明度、尺度和外观掩盖，导致渲染看似合理但几何错误。现有正则方法仅约束观测视角，而视频扩散方法虽补全未见视角，却主要作为 RGB 伪监督，未充分利用运动/时序先验且缺乏显式几何监督。
method: 提出 Bi-FlowGS，以光流为桥梁连接生成式视角补全与高斯几何正则。其即插即用的 V2G 将恢复视频中的时序对应先验蒸馏到高斯几何以缓解 Geometry Cheating，反向的 G2V 则用当前 3DGS 几何引导时序一致视频恢复，二者构成隐式双向协同精炼，使恢复视频与优化后的 3DGS 场景迭代互促。
result: 实验在宽基线与无界 360° 基准上表明，Bi-FlowGS 提升了渲染质量和几何一致性；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: Bi-FlowGS 贡献在于通过双向光流协同精炼，将视频生成先验有效转化为高斯几何监督，缓解稀疏视角下的 Geometry Cheating。该方法有望提升稀疏视角 3DGS 重建的鲁棒性、几何可靠性和新视角合成质量。

title: Evaluating Mesh Reconstruction Methods for Crop Phenotyping
abstract: Phenotyping an agricultural crop is crucial for studying its entire life cycle, as it provides vital insights to improve yield and, ultimately, food production. Doing the same for crops grown on remote sites is a challenge for the specialists who cannot be available on-site. 3D reconstruction techniques offer a promising solution to this problem by enabling crop digitization, allowing specialists to access the resulting 3D crop models from anywhere at any time. In this work, we evaluate recent 3D reconstruction pipelines for crop phenotyping. We focus on 7 mesh reconstruction pipelines and measure the fidelity and consistency of their outputs qualitatively and quantitatively. Our results suggest that the meshes produced by the GGGS, PGSR, and 2DGS are preferable to the other pipelines, owing to their quantitative metrics and visually pleasing outputs. The GGGS pipeline is better than the second-best pipeline (2DGS) by about 27\% on the radar chart with 5 dimensions, namely, User ratings, Chamfer distance, LPIPS, PSNR, and SSIM.
tldr: 评估7种网格重建流程用于作物表型，GGGS、PGSR与2DGS较优，GGGS综合领先约27%。
motivation: 远程站点的作物表型分析依赖专家现场观察，但专家难以到场；3D重建可将作物数字化，使专家远程随时访问3D模型，因此需评估现有网格重建流程在作物表型中的保真度与一致性。
method: 本文针对作物表型评估7种网格重建流程，通过定性与定量方式衡量其输出网格的保真度和一致性，定量指标包括用户评分、Chamfer distance、LPIPS、PSNR与SSIM。
result: 结果表明GGGS、PGSR和2DGS生成的网格在定量指标和视觉效果上优于其他流程；其中GGGS在5维雷达图上比次优的2DGS高约27%。
conclusion: 该研究说明GGGS、PGSR和2DGS等流程可用于作物表型三维重建，GGGS综合表现最佳，为远程作物数字化与表型分析提供了可参考的方案选择。

title: HLC-GS: Risk-Map-Guided Height-Layer Consistency Gaussian Splatting for DSM Reconstruction from Optical Satellite Imagery
abstract: A Digital Surface Model (DSM) is a fundamental geospatial data product for representing the elevation of the Earth's surface. Recently, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has shown considerable potential for DSM reconstruction from multi-view optical satellite imagery due to its explicit scene representation and efficient optimization. However, in 3DGS-based DSM generation, alpha-weighted aggregation of Gaussian altitudes may blend splats from different height layers at the same rendered pixel or DSM sampling location, producing non-physical intermediate elevations and height-layer mixing errors. To address this problem, we propose HLC-GS, a risk-map-guided height-layer consistency Gaussian Splatting method for DSM reconstruction from optical satellite imagery. HLC-GS consists of a risk map module, a dominant-layer reliability correction module, and a secondary-layer suppression module. The risk map localizes high-risk pixels with abnormal height dispersion and unreliable dominant-layer responses, while the latter two modules regularize unreliable dominant-layer responses and suppress weakly supported far secondary-layer responses. Extensive experiments are conducted on the DFC2019 and IARPA2016 datasets. Compared with six state-of-the-art DSM reconstruction methods, HLC-GS achieves better overall accuracy. Compared with the latest and precision-enhanced EOGS, HLC-GS reduces the average MAE from 1.46 m to 1.18 m and the average RMSE from 2.78 m to 2.58 m over the evaluated scenes, while improving PAG$_{2.5}$ from 86.09\% to 88.61\%. Overall, these results demonstrate that explicitly modeling per-pixel height-layer consistency alleviates height-layer mixing and improves the geometric quality of 3DGS-based DSM reconstruction from optical satellite imagery.
tldr: 提出风险图引导的高度层一致性3DGS方法HLC-GS，用于光学卫星影像DSM重建并抑制高度层混合。
motivation: 3DGS用于多视图光学卫星影像DSM重建时，同一渲染像素或DSM采样位置处不同高度层高斯经alpha加权聚合会相互混合，产生非物理中间高程和高度层混合误差。
method: HLC-GS包含风险图模块、主层可靠性校正模块和次层抑制模块；风险图定位高度离散异常且主层响应不可靠的高风险像素，后两模块分别正则化不可靠主层响应并抑制弱支撑的远次层响应。
result: 在DFC2019和IARPA2016数据集上，与六种SOTA DSM重建方法相比HLC-GS整体精度更优；相较精度增强的EOGS，平均MAE由1.46 m降至1.18 m，RMSE由2.78 m降至2.58 m，PAG_2.5由86.09%提升至88.61%。
conclusion: 结果表明，显式建模逐像素高度层一致性可缓解高度层混合，提升光学卫星影像3DGS DSM重建的几何质量。

title: PriorPose: Reference-Guided Joint Deformation and Alignment for Category-Level Object Pose Estimation
abstract: Category-level object pose estimation seeks to recover a similarity transform $(R,t,s)$ for unseen instances without instance-specific CAD models. Most competitive methods are correspondence-based: prior-free variants regress canonical (NOCS) coordinates directly from local observations and implicitly memorize the canonical frame in the weights, which ties the parameters to category-typical orientations and hurts generalization under distribution shift; prior-based variants introduce a category prior but typically follow a serial deform-then-align pipeline, where underconstrained canonical completion can corrupt correspondences and induce error cascades in pose. We propose PriorPose, a reference-guided correspondence framework that keeps the category prior explicit and solves canonicalization and alignment jointly in a shared feature space. A reference-guided seeded transformer embeds the partial observation and the category prior as token sets and fuses them via geometry-aware seeds, from which the network jointly predicts a per-point NOCS field for visible points and a canonical deformation of the prior that reconstructs a full canonical instance, while a deep pose head regresses $(R,t,s)$ from the induced correspondences. A two-part shape consistency objective, with canonical-space and camera-space consistency losses, couples correspondence, deformation, and pose, reducing reliance on memorized canonical orientations and avoiding deform-then-align error cascades. Experiments on standard and larger-category benchmarks demonstrate that PriorPose sets new state-of-the-art results on most evaluated metrics, especially under strict pose thresholds, while remaining competitive on relaxed pose and IoU metrics and showing improved robustness under shape variation and domain shift.
tldr: PriorPose提出参考引导的联合变形与对齐框架，通过显式类别先验和共享特征空间提升类别级物体位姿估计的泛化能力。
motivation: 现有对应关系方法中，无先验方法直接回归NOCS坐标并隐式记忆规范帧，导致参数与类别典型朝向绑定，在分布偏移下泛化差；有先验方法采用串行“先变形后对齐”，欠约束的规范补全会污染对应关系并引发位姿误差级联。
method: PriorPose将类别先验显式保留，并用参考引导的种子Transformer把部分观测与类别先验作为token集融合；网络联合预测可见点的逐点NOCS场和先验的规范变形，以重建完整规范实例，再由深度位姿头从诱导对应关系回归(R,t,s)。两项形状一致性目标（规范空间与相机空间一致性损失）耦合对应、变形与位姿。
result: 在标准及更大类别基准上，PriorPose在多数评估指标上取得新的SOTA，尤其在严格位姿阈值下提升明显；在宽松位姿和IoU指标上保持竞争力，并提升形状变化与域偏移下的鲁棒性；摘要未给出具体数值。
conclusion: PriorPose通过参考引导的联合变形与对齐及双空间形状一致性约束，显式利用类别先验并避免串行流水线的误差级联，为类别级物体位姿估计提供了更泛化、更鲁棒的对应关系框架。

title: MAETrack: Unleashing the Potential of Pretrained Geometric Priors for 3D Single Object Tracking
abstract: Large-scale pre-training has transformed representation learning in 2D vision, yet its transferability to 3D single object tracking (SOT) remains insufficiently understood. Directly fine-tuning self-supervised 3D encoders, such as masked autoencoders (MAE), often leads to sub-optimal adaptation because the reconstruction objective is not fully aligned with the spatial-temporal matching requirements of tracking. In this paper, we observe that this difficulty can be interpreted as a layer-wise transfer mismatch: shallow layers tend to preserve transferable geometric cues, while deeper layers become increasingly specialized to the reconstruction pretext task and are less suitable for downstream tracking. Based on this observation, we propose MAETrack, a lightweight adaptation framework for transferring pre-training MAE representations to 3D SOT. MAETrack includes Layer-Selective Initialization (LSI), which initializes only the shallow stages of the tracking backbone from pre-trained weights while re-initializing deeper stages, and Geometric Residual Gating (GRG), which reinforces structurally salient regions in the search BEV features before template-search fusion through residual spatial modulation. Extensive experiments on standard 3D SOT benchmarks show that MAETrack consistently improves upon vanilla fine-tuning baselines with limited computational overhead. More broadly, our results suggest that effective transfer from 3D reconstruction pre-training to 3D tracking is not merely a matter of partial fine-tuning, but depends on a tracking-oriented transfer principle that preserves shallow geometry while adapting deeper representations to the downstream objective.
tldr: 提出MAETrack，通过层选择性初始化与几何残差门控，将MAE预训练表征高效迁移至3D单目标跟踪。
motivation: 3D单目标跟踪中直接微调MAE等自监督3D编码器效果次优，原因是重建目标与跟踪所需的时空匹配不一致；作者进一步发现浅层保留可迁移几何线索，深层过度特化于重建任务，造成逐层迁移失配。
method: 提出轻量适配框架MAETrack：层选择性初始化（LSI）仅用预训练权重初始化跟踪骨干浅层，深层重新初始化；几何残差门控（GRG）在模板-搜索融合前通过残差空间调制增强搜索BEV特征中的结构显著区域。
result: 在标准3D单目标跟踪基准上，MAETrack以有限计算开销持续优于朴素微调基线；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 结果表明，从3D重建预训练到3D跟踪的有效迁移不仅是部分微调，而需遵循面向跟踪的迁移原则：保留浅层几何并适配深层表征至下游目标。

title: Lesion-centered 3D mapping of colonoscopy procedures: validation of a hierarchical ensemble pipeline on public benchmark videos
abstract: Background and Objective: Colonoscopy recording practice preserves text reports and still photographs, while the spatial information already present in the recorded video - where the scope traveled, where a lesion was observed, and whether the same lesion was seen again - is discarded when the procedure ends. This study determines whether a lesion-centered spatial record can be assembled and validated without full-colon 3D reconstruction. Methods: A four-layer hierarchical pipeline was assembled - (1) a global topological map, (2) lesion-level spatio-temporal tracks, (3) on-demand local 3D reconstruction, and (4) persistent lesion identity across repeated observations - and ran end to end on four public videos (two C3VDv2 sequences with ground-truth depth and two full REAL-Colon procedures; 40,245 frames). All components are published, individually validated methods; the contribution is their lesion-centered assembly, linking rules, and evaluation. Results: Revisits, impossible under forward-only mapping by construction, were detected by entry-map Bayesian localization: 5,614 and 4,043 revisit events (56 and 68 distinct nodes) in the two full procedures. Lesion-identity merging at the adopted threshold 0.5 maintained ground-truth purity 1.0 while auto-merging 20 of 231 candidate pairs. The endoscopy-specific geometry engine outperformed a general-purpose foundation model on all metrics (overall absolute relative error (AbsRel) 0.2276 vs. 0.3523). Conclusions: The results are partial but establish a concrete near-term path: revisit detection, lesion identity, and local 3D each returned quantitative, reproducible output without waiting for complete geometric reconstruction; validating the record on clinical data is the next step.
tldr: 提出以病灶为中心的四层结肠镜空间建图流程，并在公开视频上验证重访检测、病灶身份合并与局部3D重建。
motivation: 结肠镜记录实践通常仅保留文本报告和静态照片，而视频中已有的空间信息——镜身行进路径、病灶观察位置以及同一病灶是否被再次观察到——在检查结束后即被丢弃。本研究旨在不依赖全结肠3D重建的情况下，构建并验证以病灶为中心的空间记录。
method: 构建四层分层流程：全局拓扑图、病灶级时空轨迹、按需局部3D重建、跨重复观察的持久病灶身份，并在四段公开视频（两段C3VDv2序列含深度真值、两段完整REAL-Colon操作，共40245帧）上端到端运行。所用组件均为已发表且单独验证的方法，本文贡献在于以病灶为中心的集成、链接规则与评估。
result: 入口图贝叶斯定位检测到前向建图无法实现的重访：两段完整操作分别有5614和4043次重访事件、56和68个不同节点；阈值0.5下病灶身份合并保持真值纯度1.0，并自动合并231对候选中的20对；内镜专用几何引擎在所有指标上优于通用基础模型，总体AbsRel为0.2276对0.3523。
conclusion: 结果虽部分但确立了近期可行路径：重访检测、病灶身份与局部3D均无需等待完整几何重建即可输出定量、可复现结果；下一步是在临床数据上验证该空间记录。

title: G3AR: Graph-Guided Neural Visual Geometry for Scalable Multi-Sequence Aerial Registration
abstract: Full-context neural visual geometry is impractical for thousands of images, while sequence-based chunking poorly captures irregular non-local overlap in multi-sequence aerial collections. We present Graph-Guided Neural Visual Geometry for Aerial Registration (G3AR), a graph-guided framework for scalable dense neural geometry. Before local inference, G3AR builds a geometrically verified image-proximity graph that guides bounded overlapping chunks and induces a chunk graph whose maximum spanning tree defines alignment topology. Compatible backbones process chunks independently; shared-image predictions then estimate three-dimensional similarity (Sim(3)) transforms that register local cameras and geometry in a common frame. Across four real aerial scenes, G3AR improves pose error and runtime in matched VGGT- and Pi3-backed comparisons, while its DA3 variant achieves the lowest pose error among evaluated neural-geometry methods.
tldr: G3AR 用几何验证图像邻近图引导分块与 Sim(3) 对齐，实现可扩展多序列航拍配准。
motivation: 全上下文神经视觉几何难以处理数千张图像，而按序列分块又无法有效捕捉多序列航拍采集中不规则的非局部重叠。该工作旨在实现可扩展的稠密神经几何航拍配准。
method: G3AR 先构建经过几何验证的图像邻近图，用于引导有界重叠分块，并生成分块图，以最大生成树定义对齐拓扑；兼容骨干网络独立处理各分块，再借共享图像预测估计 Sim(3) 变换，将局部相机与几何统一到公共坐标系。
result: 在四个真实航拍场景中，匹配 VGGT 和 Pi3 骨干的对比显示，G3AR 同时改善位姿误差与运行时间；其 DA3 变体在所评估的神经几何方法中取得最低位姿误差。
conclusion: G3AR 通过图引导分块与 Sim(3) 对齐，为大规模多序列航拍配准提供了可扩展的稠密神经几何框架，并验证了其相对现有神经几何方法的精度与效率优势。

title: CALIPER: Metric-Grounded Model-Free Recognition of Visually Similar Industrial Parts
abstract: Fine-grained recognition of visually similar industrial parts is challenging when classes differ primarily in physical dimensions. Normalizing detected object crops to a fixed input size suppresses absolute scale, while CAD models and large class-specific datasets may be unavailable in evolving industrial inventories. We present CALIPER, a model-free RGB-D framework that couples support-based appearance matching with metric size evidence. Each training class is onboarded from a single turntable RGB-D video and one to two labeled real images; 3D reconstruction provides novel-view appearance support, while aligned depth yields a class-specific metric size profile. At inference, a coarse YOLOv8n-seg model localizes parts, and a frozen DINOv2 backbone with an episodically trained embedding head performs fine-grained support matching. Margin-conditioned metric fusion activates probabilistic size evidence only for appearance-ambiguous decisions. New classes are enrolled from a small RGB-D support set without updating network parameters. We evaluate CALIPER on 18 visually similar industrial parts: 16 classes are used for training, while two screws are reserved for training-free enrollment. CALIPER achieves 88.2% closed-set accuracy with 99.8% localization recall and 85.7% overall accuracy after 10-shot enrollment of the two unseen screws. Metric fusion improves unseen-class accuracy by up to 37.4 percentage points without statistically significant degradation of the original inventory. Robot-arm deployment identifies 17/18 parts without deployment-specific retraining.
tldr: CALIPER 提出无模型 RGB-D 框架，融合外观支持匹配与度量尺寸证据，实现相似工业零件识别与免训练新类注册。
motivation: 工业库存中视觉相似零件常仅由物理尺寸区分，将检测裁剪归一化会丢失绝对尺度，而 CAD 模型和大规模类特定数据集往往不可得。现有方法难以在动态新增类别时快速扩展。
method: CALIPER 为每个类仅用单段转台 RGB-D 视频和 1–2 张标注真实图像注册：3D 重建生成新视角外观支持，对齐深度构建类级度量尺寸轮廓；推理时 YOLOv8n-seg 粗定位，冻结 DINOv2 加情节式训练嵌入头做细粒度支持匹配，并以边缘条件度量融合在出现外观歧义时激活概率尺寸证据。
result: 在 18 类视觉相似工业零件上，16 类训练、2 类螺钉留作免训练注册；闭集准确率 88.2%，定位召回率 99.8%，对两未见过螺钉 10-shot 注册后总体准确率 85.7%。度量融合将未见类准确率最高提升 37.4 个百分点，且未显著降低原库存性能；机械臂部署无需针对部署重训即可识别 17/18 个零件。
conclusion: 该工作表明无需更新网络参数即可通过小规模 RGB-D 支持集注册新类，并利用度量尺寸证据显著改善外观相似零件识别，适用于动态工业库存与机器人操作。

title: Wind on Trees: Testing Physical Grounding in Dynamic 4D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Monocular reconstruction of wind-driven vegetation is severely underconstrained: motion along the viewing direction is largely unobservable, a moving canopy offers few reliable correspondences, and nearly the entire scene is dynamic, providing little static reference. Directly-learned deformation fields in 4D Gaussian Splatting therefore optimize photometric consistency rather than recover the motion that produced it. We replace that field with a physically parameterized deformation prior: one damped harmonic oscillator per rigid part, driven by the observed wind and integrated by differentiable RK4, supervised photometrically alone. To test whether such a prior is physically grounded rather than merely well fit, we build a controlled synthetic testbed of three procedurally generated trees spanning an order of magnitude in skeleton complexity, whose per-part natural frequency follows from its own geometry and whose damping ratio is a fixed constant, both held out of training. On it, we measure held-out views, temporal extrapolation, zero-shot transfer to unseen wind speeds, and recovery of the physical parameters themselves. The prior costs appearance fidelity on in-distribution views and extrapolates markedly better outside the training window and the training wind, while parameter recovery is far weaker than it first appears: frequency recovery survives an untrained null control on only the sparsest of the three trees, and damping is not recovered at all.
tldr: 用阻尼谐振子物理先验替代4DGS形变场，提升外推但物理参数恢复有限。
motivation: 单目风驱植被重建严重欠约束：沿视向运动不可观测、动态冠层对应稀缺且几乎全场景动态缺乏静态参考；现有4DGS直接学习形变场倾向于优化光度一致性，而非恢复产生运动的物理机制。
method: 以每个刚性部件一个阻尼谐振子作为物理参数化形变先验，由观测风驱动并用可微RK4积分，仅用光度监督训练；同时构建三棵程序生成树的受控合成测试床，骨架复杂度跨一个数量级，其自然频率由部件几何决定、阻尼比固定，二者在训练中留出。
result: 该先验牺牲分布内视角的外观保真度，但在训练时间窗和训练风速之外外推显著更好；物理参数恢复却远弱于表面表现：频率恢复仅在三种树中最稀疏的一棵上优于未训练零控制，阻尼完全未被恢复。
conclusion: 研究表明物理参数化先验可改善动态4DGS在训练窗口与风速外的外推，但参数恢复结果警示不能仅凭拟合优度声称物理基础；贡献在于提出该先验、受控合成测试床及涵盖外推与参数恢复的评估协议。

title: The Neverwhere Visual Parkour Benchmark Suite
abstract: State-of-the-art visual locomotion controllers are increasingly capable at handling complex visual environments, making evaluating their real-world performance before deployment increasingly difficult. This work intends to narrow this train/evaluation gap by developing a collection of hyper-photo-realistic, closed-loop evaluation environments - The Neverwhere Benchmark Suite - comprised of over sixty 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructions of urban indoor and outdoor scenes. Our goal is to encourage large-scale and reproducible robot evaluation by making it easier to create and integrate Gaussian splats-based reconstructions into simulated continuous testing setups. We also underscore the potential pitfalls of relying exclusively on 3D Gaussian-generated data for training, by providing policy checkpoints trained over multiple Neverwhere scenes and their performance when evaluated in novel scenes. Our analysis illustrates the necessity of sourcing diverse data to ensure performance. Code and data are available on the project page: https://ziyc.github.io/neverwhere-bench/.
tldr: 提出Neverwhere基准套件，用60多个3DGS城市场景闭环评估视觉运动控制器。
motivation: 当前先进视觉运动控制器能应对复杂视觉环境，但部署前评估其真实世界性能仍然困难；该工作旨在缩小训练与评估之间的差距，并推动大规模、可复现的机器人评估。
method: 构建Neverwhere Benchmark Suite，包含60多个基于3D Gaussian Splatting重建的城市室内外场景，形成超写实闭环评估环境，并简化将Gaussian splats重建集成到模拟连续测试流程中的方式。同时提供在多个Neverwhere场景上训练的策略检查点，用于在新场景中评估性能。
result: 提供了60多个3DGS重建场景构成的闭环评估基准，并给出多场景训练策略在新场景中的评估结果；摘要未提供具体量化指标，但指出仅依赖3D Gaussian生成数据训练存在性能隐患。
conclusion: 分析表明，为确保策略性能，必须引入多样化数据来源；该基准有助于促进大规模、可复现的机器人评估，代码与数据已在项目页面公开。

title: Racing in Volume with Flow Ensembles
abstract: Streaming 4D reconstruction has been demonstrated only indoors, on dense camera rigs surrounding subjects that move at human pace. Outdoor 4D reconstruction exists but relies either on cameras mounted on the moving vehicle itself, or on limited-coverage arrays observing quasi-static subjects offline. The case that actually matters for spectators is a fast-moving subject, watched from a sparse ring of allocentric cameras, streaming. No method targets this, and no benchmark exists to evaluate one. To this end, we introduce FastFlowGS, a streaming 4D Gaussian Splatting method for reconstructing fast-moving subjects from a small set of fixed external cameras, and Monaco4D, a photorealistic Unreal Engine 5 benchmark for high-speed outdoor reconstruction. FastFlowGS fuses sparse matches, semi-dense tracks, and dense optical flow by lifting each signal to 3D with geometric uncertainty and combining them through a Kalman-style temporal update. Monaco4D provides Formula 1 sequences under varied illumination from trackside, onboard, and drone viewpoints with dense ground truth. On CMU-Panoptic, FastFlowGS exceeds the strongest baseline by 12.6% VMAF at 35% greater efficiency. On Monaco4D, where existing streaming methods degrade severely, it improves dynamic-region PSNR by up to 18.6% with 28.3% lower per-frame optimization time. Dataset and additional details can be found at https://humansensinglab.github.io/monaco4d/.
tldr: 提出FastFlowGS流式4D高斯泼溅与Monaco4D基准，实现稀疏固定相机下高速运动目标重建。
motivation: 现有流式4D重建仅限室内密集相机阵列且目标以人类速度运动；户外4D重建则依赖车载相机或覆盖有限的阵列离线观测准静态目标。对于观众真正关心的场景——稀疏全中心相机环形阵列流式观测高速运动目标——尚无方法和基准。
method: 提出FastFlowGS，一种从少量固定外部相机流式重建高速运动目标的4D高斯泼溅方法；它融合稀疏匹配、半稠密轨迹和稠密光流，将各信号以几何不确定性提升到3D，并通过Kalman式时序更新组合。同时提出Monaco4D，基于Unreal Engine 5的高保真高速户外重建基准，包含不同光照下赛道边、车载和无人机视角的F1序列及稠密真值。
result: 在CMU-Panoptic上，FastFlowGS以35%更高效率超过最强基线12.6% VMAF。在Monaco4D上，现有流式方法严重退化，而FastFlowGS将动态区域PSNR最多提升18.6%，并将逐帧优化时间降低28.3%。
conclusion: FastFlowGS为稀疏固定全中心相机下高速户外流式4D重建提供了有效方案，Monaco4D填补了相应评测基准空白。该工作有望推动体育直播、赛车等高速动态场景的实时4D重建与观众体验应用。

title: SceneBench: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Vision-Language Understanding of 3D Scenes
abstract:
Vision-language models excel at 2D image understanding but remain limited in 3D spatial reasoning. Progress is hindered by limitations in current benchmarks. First, 3D datasets often rely on point clouds that capture geometry but discard rich visual features like texture, text, and materials. Second, annotations treat objects in isolation while ignoring real-world hierarchical organization (scenes, rooms, functional areas, object groups). Third, evaluation tasks focus narrowly on basic recognition rather than multi-step spatial reasoning.
  In this context, we introduce SceneBench, a benchmark of 966 photorealistic 3D scenes reconstructed with Gaussian Splatting and densely annotated with hierarchical semantics spanning scenes, rooms, functional areas, object groups, and individual objects. These annotations are produced through a human-in-the-loop pipeline combining vision-language models with roughly 1,500 human-hours of iterative refinement and verification, producing over 183K annotated nodes with textual descriptions and 3D bounding boxes. Building on this representation, we define three evaluation tasks: Existence-Based Questions probing object attributes, Spatial Intelligence Questions covering counting, size comparison, distance, and directional relations, and Grounded Question-Reasoning-Answer (QRA) triplets requiring multi-step reasoning across semantic levels. Experiments with state-of-the-art vision-language models show that while models perform well on basic recognition tasks (e.g., up to 85% accuracy for detection), performance drops substantially on hierarchical and compositional reasoning (e.g., down to 60% for counting), revealing limitations not captured by existing benchmarks. SceneBench provides a realistic testbed for developing and evaluating models capable of fine-grained spatial reasoning in photorealistic 3D environments.
tldr: SceneBench 是面向真实感3D场景的层次化视觉语言理解基准，揭示模型在多步空间推理上的不足。
motivation: 现有3D基准多依赖点云，丢失纹理、文字和材质等视觉特征；标注常孤立处理物体，忽略场景、房间、功能区、物体组等层次结构；评测任务也偏基础识别，缺乏多步空间推理。
method: 提出SceneBench，包含966个用Gaussian Splatting重建的真实感3D场景，并以人机回环流程结合视觉语言模型和约1500小时人工迭代精修，构建超183K个带文本描述与3D边界框的层次语义节点。定义存在性问答、空间智能问答（计数、大小比较、距离、方向关系）和需跨语义层级多步推理的Grounded QRA三元组三类任务。
result: 实验显示当前先进视觉语言模型在基础识别上表现较好（如检测最高约85%准确率），但在层次化和组合推理上显著下降（如计数最低约60%），暴露出既有基准未覆盖的局限。
conclusion: SceneBench为在真实感3D环境中开发和评估细粒度空间推理模型提供了现实测试平台，其结果表明层次语义与多步推理仍是视觉语言模型的重要短板。

title: SURE-Map: Self-Correcting Streaming Geometric Foundation Model
abstract: Streaming geometric foundation models are emerging as a compelling alternative to SLAM systems. Yet this streaming nature introduces a fundamental issue: each prediction is made from limited context, which is vulnerable to dynamic objects and weak textures. Small local errors accumulate into severe geometric distortion and long-horizon scale drift. We argue that reliable streaming reconstruction requires geometric foundation models to be not only predictive, but also self-correcting. We introduce SURE-Map, a self-correcting framework built upon two complementary principles. First, we explicitly model cross-view geometric uncertainty. Unlike conventional depth or point confidence, which primarily reflects the reliability of individual-view prediction, our uncertainty directly measures whether the jointly predicted pose and depth induce geometrically consistent cross-view pixel correspondences. Second, because local correction alone cannot eliminate slowly accumulating scale errors, we introduce multi-timescale self-correction: fast consecutive-frame inference preserves streaming efficiency, while sparse keyframe-window inference provides longer-range geometric evidence to periodically recalibrate the scale of recent trajectories. SURE-Map establishes new state-of-the-art performance for online feed-forward reconstruction across long-horizon benchmarks, reducing ATE-RMSE from 24.00 to 17.24 m on KITTI, 5.11 to 4.74 m on Oxford Spires, and 31.37 to 28.58 m on VBR, with further improvements to 15.17, 4.63, and 22.12 m when incorporating loop-closure refinement. Project page: https://mingkai-liu.github.io/projects/sure-map/.
tldr: SURE-Map通过跨视角几何不确定性与多时间尺度自校正，提升流式几何基础模型的长期重建精度并抑制尺度漂移。
motivation: 流式几何基础模型正成为SLAM系统的重要替代方案，但其逐帧预测仅依赖有限上下文，易受动态物体和弱纹理影响。局部小误差会累积为严重几何畸变和长时程尺度漂移，因此可靠流式重建需要模型不仅具备预测能力，还能自我校正。
method: SURE-Map提出两个互补原则：一是显式建模跨视角几何不确定性，直接度量联合预测的位姿与深度是否产生几何一致的跨视角像素对应，而非仅评估单视角预测置信度；二是多时间尺度自校正，快速连续帧推理保持流式效率，稀疏关键帧窗口推理提供更长距离几何证据，周期性重校准近期轨迹尺度，并可结合回环闭合优化。
result: 在长时程在线前馈重建基准上，SURE-Map取得新的SOTA，将ATE-RMSE在KITTI上从24.00降至17.24 m，在Oxford Spires上从5.11降至4.74 m，在VBR上从31.37降至28.58 m；加入回环闭合优化后进一步降至15.17、4.63和22.12 m。
conclusion: SURE-Map证明流式几何基础模型可通过跨视角不确定性建模和多时间尺度自校正显著缓解误差累积与尺度漂移，为长时程在线重建提供了更鲁棒的框架。该工作对SLAM替代方案、几何基础模型及实际机器人/自动驾驶建图具有潜在推动作用。

title: Multi-Stage NeRF for Efficient 3D Coronary Artery Reconstruction from Two Narrow-Angle Angiographic Projections
abstract: X-ray coronary angiography is the clinical gold standard for coronary artery disease during real-time cardiac interventions, but provides only 2D projections of inherently 3D vessels. Existing learning-based 2D-to-3D reconstruction methods typically require wide angular coverage or multiple views, assumptions that are rarely satisfied in routine practice where only two projections with narrow angular separation are available. To address these challenges, we propose NeCA++, a multi-stage self-supervised neural radiance field (NeRF) framework tailored to clinically realistic acquisition constraints. The framework decomposes reconstruction into two stages that progressively refine spatial support and representation capacity. In the first stage, a coarse 3D representation of the vasculature is reconstructed, restricting the subsequent optimisation to regions with a higher likelihood of vessel presence, termed an active region. Afterward reconstruction is restricted to this region while higher-resolution representations are progressively activated to recover fine vascular details. This multi-stage strategy focuses learning on anatomically plausible regions, mitigates gradient dilution under extreme sparsity, and stabilises global topology before recovering fine vascular branches. Furthermore, two vessel-specific regularisations are introduced: a ray-aligned constraint to reduce projection-induced ambiguity, and a bimodal density penalty to enable early vessel-background separation. Extensive experiments across three datasets (ImageCAS, ASOCA, and Synthetic RCA) and four angular configurations demonstrate consistent superiority over state-of-the-art baselines, particularly under clinically realistic narrow-angle settings, while achieving reconstruction within 58 seconds per case.
tldr: 提出多阶段自监督NeRF框架NeCA++，仅用两幅窄角冠脉造影投影高效重建3D冠脉，每例58秒。
motivation: X射线冠脉造影仅提供3D血管的2D投影，而现有学习式2D-to-3D重建方法通常依赖宽角度覆盖或多视角，难以满足临床常规中仅有两幅窄角分离投影的现实条件。该工作旨在解决极端稀疏视角与窄角采集下的冠脉三维重建难题。
method: 提出多阶段自监督NeRF框架NeCA++，将重建分解为两阶段：先重建粗粒度血管结构并确定高概率血管存在的active region，再在该区域内限制优化并逐步激活高分辨率表示以恢复细小血管分支。同时引入两种血管特定正则：ray-aligned约束以缓解投影歧义，以及bimodal density penalty以促进血管与背景早期分离。
result: 在ImageCAS、ASOCA和Synthetic RCA三个数据集及四种角度配置上的大量实验表明，NeCA++一致优于当前最优基线，尤其在临床现实的窄角设置下优势明显，并可在每例58秒内完成重建。
conclusion: NeCA++通过多阶段自监督NeRF和血管特定正则，在仅两幅窄角投影条件下实现了高效且精细的3D冠脉重建，提升了极端稀疏视角下的重建稳定性与拓扑合理性，有望辅助实时心脏介入中的冠脉三维可视化。

title: Closed-form Bayesian homography estimation from noisy point correspondences
abstract: While homographies are fundamental to many computer vision tasks, the majority of conventional estimation techniques provide only point estimates without directly quantifying uncertainty introduced by noisy observations. Uncertainty, though, propagates to subsequent processing steps such as camera calibration and 3D reconstruction and is particularly relevant in safety-critical and socially relevant fields including medical imaging, autonomous driving, and defense. We present a fast Bayesian formulation for homography estimation from point correspondences that explicitly incorporates measurement uncertainty and prior knowledge while providing a posterior distribution over the homography parameters. A closed-form solution of the posterior mean of the homography is derived in homogeneous coordinates and supplemented by an iterative Bayesian approach to handle non-linearities. Synthetic experiments demonstrate the applicability to projective transformations and show improved estimation accuracy over DLT under varying noise conditions. Image stitching experiments further demonstrate applicability to real image correspondences while additionally providing uncertainty information.
tldr: 提出闭式贝叶斯单应性估计方法，在噪声点对应下量化不确定性并优于DLT。
motivation: 传统单应性估计多提供点估计，未直接量化噪声观测带来的不确定性；该不确定性会传播至相机标定、三维重建等后续步骤，在医疗影像、自动驾驶和国防等安全关键领域尤为重要。
method: 提出一种快速贝叶斯单应性估计框架，显式融合测量不确定性与先验知识，并给出单应性参数的后验分布；在齐次坐标下推导后验均值的闭式解，并辅以迭代贝叶斯方法处理非线性。
result: 合成实验证明该方法适用于投影变换，并在不同噪声条件下估计精度优于DLT；图像拼接实验进一步验证其适用于真实图像对应，同时能提供不确定性信息。
conclusion: 该工作为噪声点对应下的单应性估计提供了快速贝叶斯闭式解与迭代扩展，兼顾估计精度和不确定性量化，有望提升相机标定、三维重建及安全关键应用中的可靠性。

title: LG-VLN: A Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation Framework with LangGraph State Orchestration
abstract: Continuous-environment vision-and-language navigation (VLN-CE) requires interpreting natural-language instructions in unseen 3D environments and executing continuous low-level actions. Existing methods often depend on LiDAR, panoramic cameras, or extra sensors; separate geometric-mapping and semantic-navigation visual representations can cause long-trajectory spatial-semantic inconsistencies. We propose LG-VLN, a monocular zero-shot framework with shared visual features and LangGraph-based state orchestration. An online feed-forward 3D reconstruction network predicts depth, camera poses, and dense point clouds for agent-pose estimation and global map fusion. Geometry and navigation share dense CleanDIFT features: semantic consistency rejects incorrect inter-frame correspondences, while target-instance constraints define visual references whose similarity combines with local BLIP-2 image-text relevance to form a semantic value map. LangGraph represents instruction parsing, geometric perception, semantic value updates, path planning, action execution, and failure recovery as a directed state graph with conditional transitions, persistent state, and modular recovery mechanisms. On a fixed 550-episode subset of the R2R-CE val-unseen split, LG-VLN achieves 21.3% success and 12.1% success weighted by path length. Ablations show shared semantic features improve navigation, further boosted by combining visual similarity and image-text relevance. Results establish shared visual representations and explicit state orchestration as effective for zero-shot VLN-CE using monocular RGB alone. Code will be publicly released for reproducibility.
tldr: 提出单目零样本VLN框架LG-VLN，用共享视觉特征与LangGraph状态编排实现连续环境导航。
motivation: 现有VLN-CE方法常依赖LiDAR、全景相机或额外传感器，且几何建图与语义导航使用分离的视觉表示，易导致长轨迹空间-语义不一致。本文旨在仅用单目RGB实现零样本连续环境导航。
method: LG-VLN使用在线前馈3D重建网络预测深度、相机位姿与稠密点云，以估计智能体位姿并融合全局地图；几何与导航共享CleanDIFT稠密特征，通过语义一致性剔除错误帧间对应，并以目标实例约束构建视觉参考，其相似度与BLIP-2图文相关性结合形成语义值图。LangGraph将指令解析、几何感知、语义值更新、路径规划、动作执行和失败恢复组织为带条件转移、持久状态与模块化恢复机制的有向状态图。
result: 在R2R-CE val-unseen的固定550回合子集上，LG-VLN达到21.3%成功率和12.1% SPL。消融实验表明共享语义特征可提升导航性能，结合视觉相似度与图文相关性后性能进一步提升。
conclusion: 结果证明仅使用单目RGB时，共享视觉表示与显式状态编排能有效支持零样本VLN-CE。代码将公开以促进可复现研究。

title: G-ray: Ray-Level Relative Geometric Position Encoding in Multi-View Vision Transformers under Camera Heterogeneity
abstract: We study relative position encoding for multi-view vision Transformers under camera heterogeneity, including varying fields of view (FoVs) or projection models. Existing rotary relative position encodings commonly use image-plane positional coordinates, producing projection-dependent relative phases and inconsistent geometric cues for cross-projection attention. We introduce G-ray, a ray-level relative position encoding whose rotary phases are parameterized by camera-local ray angles. The same camera-local ray pair induces the same relative phase across projections, providing projection-invariant positional consistency. G-ray can be used directly or integrated with existing encodings, retaining complementary geometric cues without additional learned parameters. We validate G-ray in three host encodings, RoPE, GTA, and RayRoPE, across 3D reconstruction and novel-view synthesis (NVS). Across three heterogeneous 3D reconstruction benchmarks at 50 views, G-ray leads all six averaged metrics and reduces mean pointmap relative error by 45.8% over MapAnything, with calibration supplied to both. Trained exclusively on homogeneous pinhole images, the 3D reconstruction model handles mixed pinhole and non-pinhole inputs without retraining and remains competitive on homogeneous pinhole 3D reconstruction protocols. For NVS, GTA and RayRoPE improve with G-ray under joint viewpoint and FoV variation. The project's webpage is available at https://g-ray-project.github.io/.
tldr: G-ray用相机局部射线角度参数化旋转相位，实现跨投影一致的射线级相对位置编码，提升异构相机多视图任务。
motivation: 研究相机异构（如不同视场或投影模型）下多视图视觉Transformer的相对位置编码问题。现有旋转相对位置编码多使用图像平面坐标，导致跨投影注意力中的相对相位依赖投影、几何线索不一致。
method: 提出G-ray，以相机局部射线角度参数化旋转相位，使同一相机局部射线对在不同投影下产生相同相对相位，从而提供投影不变的位置一致性。G-ray可直接使用，也可与RoPE、GTA、RayRoPE等现有编码集成，保留互补几何线索且不增加可学习参数。
result: 在三个异构3D重建基准、50视角设置下，G-ray在六个平均指标上均领先，并将平均pointmap相对误差较MapAnything降低45.8%（双方均提供标定）。仅在均匀针孔图像上训练的3D重建模型无需重训即可处理混合针孔与非针孔输入，并在均匀针孔协议上保持竞争力；在NVS中，GTA与RayRoPE在视角和FoV联合变化下因G-ray获得提升。
conclusion: G-ray通过射线级相对位置编码解决了相机异构下的投影相关相位不一致问题，提升了跨投影注意力的几何一致性。其可即插即用并兼容现有编码，在异构相机3D重建和新视角合成中具有应用潜力。

title: What Makes a 3D Scene Editable? A Factorized Benchmark of Fidelity, Locality, Consistency, and Preservation
abstract: Neural 3D scene editing is often evaluated by semantic alignment alone, although a convincing result may alter unrelated content or become inconsistent across views. We introduce EditBench3D, a representation-agnostic benchmark that treats editing as controlled information replacement. It evaluates four complementary properties: instruction fidelity, spatial locality, cross-view consistency, and preservation of non-target content. The protocol combines visibility-aware 3D target supports, paired descriptions, held-out cameras, and five edit families covering appearance, material, geometry, and object-level changes. We evaluate eight representative NeRF, 3D Gaussian Splatting, hybrid, and proxy-based editors on 240 scene-edit pairs. The study shows that semantic fidelity is only weakly associated with the other editing properties, and that no single method is optimal across all dimensions. Explicit Gaussian editors offer a strong overall balance, whereas direct proxy manipulation provides the most conservative edits at the cost of open-ended fidelity. These findings support reporting editability as a multi-objective profile rather than a single semantic score.
tldr: 提出EditBench3D，从保真度、局部性、一致性与非目标保持四方面多目标评测3D场景编辑。
motivation: 现有神经3D场景编辑多仅用语义对齐评价，可能忽略无关内容被改动或跨视图不一致的问题。该工作希望将编辑评测转向表示无关、可控信息替换的多维基准。
method: 构建EditBench3D，将编辑视为受控信息替换，结合可见性感知3D目标支撑、配对描述、留出相机及五类编辑家族（外观、材质、几何、物体级）。在240个场景-编辑对上评测八种代表性NeRF、3D Gaussian Splatting、混合与代理式编辑器。
result: 实验表明语义保真度与其他编辑属性仅弱相关，且没有单一方法在所有维度上最优。显式高斯编辑器总体平衡较强，直接代理操纵编辑最保守但开放式保真度受限。
conclusion: 该研究贡献了多维可编辑性评测框架，并主张将3D场景编辑能力报告为多目标剖面而非单一语义分数，为后续编辑方法比较提供更全面依据。

title: SCOUT-SLAM: Structurally-Coupled Dual Uncertainty-Aware 3DGS SLAM in the Wild
abstract: Recently, 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM (3DGS-SLAM) has gained significant momentum in simultaneous localization and 3DGS scene reconstruction. In real-world scenarios with rapid camera motion and cluttered dynamic environments, existing methods rely on the stability of the underlying scene reconstruction to model uncertainty. This leads to a circular dependency between camera tracking accuracy and reconstruction quality: reconstruction instabilities degrade uncertainty modeling, which affects accurate camera tracking and static scene reconstruction. To address this, the paper proposes SCOUT-SLAM, a structurally-coupled dual-uncertainty framework in which both uncertainties are estimated from a shared base network. A low-rank adaptation of this network, trained on multi-view feature consistency, estimates a tracking uncertainty that does not depend solely on the reconstruction quality. A spatially-adaptive prior modulates the network's training objective so that reconstruction instability does not inflate uncertainty on static regions, keeping the shared representation intact for both branches. Evaluations on dynamic benchmarks (TUM RGB-D, Bonn Dynamic, Wild-SLAM MoCap) demonstrate that SCOUT-SLAM achieves state-of-the-art camera tracking accuracy and artifact-free static scene reconstruction.
tldr: 提出结构耦合双不确定性3DGS-SLAM，在动态环境中实现SOTA跟踪与无伪影重建。
motivation: 现有3DGS-SLAM在快速运动和杂乱动态场景中依赖重建稳定性来建模不确定性，导致相机跟踪精度与重建质量形成循环依赖：重建不稳定会破坏不确定性建模，进而影响跟踪与静态场景重建。
method: SCOUT-SLAM从共享基础网络估计跟踪与重建两种不确定性；通过多视角特征一致性训练低秩适应模块，使跟踪不确定性不单独依赖重建质量；并用空间自适应先验调制训练目标，避免重建不稳定抬高静态区域不确定性，从而保持共享表示完整。
result: 在 TUM RGB-D、Bonn Dynamic 和 Wild-SLAM MoCap 等动态基准上，SCOUT-SLAM 达到 SOTA 相机跟踪精度，并实现无伪影静态场景重建；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: SCOUT-SLAM 通过结构耦合双不确定性缓解跟踪与重建的循环依赖，提升野外动态场景鲁棒性，为 3DGS-SLAM 中的不确定性建模与鲁棒跟踪提供了新思路。

title: CGGT: Curve-Grounded Geometry Transformer for 3D Parametric Curve Reconstruction
abstract: Recovering editable 3D parametric curves from 2D images is a fundamental challenge in computer graphics, bridging pixel-based perception and vector-based CAD modeling. Existing NeRF- and 3DGS-based methods often rely on dense calibrated views, precomputed 2D edge maps, and costly per-scene optimization, limiting their applicability to casually captured real-world inputs. We propose CGGT, a Curve-Grounded Geometry Transformer that directly grounds 3D-consistent 2D curve instances in the image space from sparse, unposed multi-view images. CGGT combines a geometry-aware transformer encoder for multi-view feature learning with a curve-aware masked-attention decoder for cross-view instance association. In a single forward pass, it predicts camera parameters, dense depth maps, and instance-level 2D curve masks, which are then lifted into 3D and refined through a fast parametric optimization stage to recover compact, editable 3D curve primitives. To support structured curve learning, we introduce Wireframe-100K, a large-scale dataset comprising 100,000 CAD models with diverse topologies, realistic multi-view renderings, and accurate parametric curve annotations. Extensive experiments show that our framework achieves substantial improvements in both reconstruction accuracy and efficiency, particularly under challenging sparse-view settings and in separating persistent 3D structural edges from view-dependent image edges caused by silhouettes, textures, and appearance variations. Despite being trained solely on synthetic data, CGGT generalizes well to real-world images, demonstrating its potential for practical CAD-style wireframe reconstruction from unconstrained visual inputs.
tldr: CGGT 从稀疏无位姿多视图图像直接重建可编辑的 3D 参数曲线。
motivation: 从 2D 图像恢复可编辑 3D 参数曲线是计算机图形学与 CAD 建模之间的关键问题；现有 NeRF/3DGS 方法依赖密集标定视图、预计算 2D 边缘图和昂贵的逐场景优化，难以适用于随手拍摄的真实输入。
method: 提出 CGGT，一种曲线锚定的几何 Transformer：用几何感知 Transformer 编码器学习多视图特征，用曲线感知掩码注意力解码器进行跨视图实例关联；单次前向预测相机参数、稠密深度图和实例级 2D 曲线掩码，再提升到 3D 并经快速参数优化恢复紧凑、可编辑的 3D 曲线基元。同时构建 Wireframe-100K 大规模数据集，含 100,000 个 CAD 模型、多样拓扑、真实感多视图渲染及精确参数曲线标注。
result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，但称大量实验表明该框架在重建精度与效率上均有显著提升，尤其在稀疏视图下，并能区分持久 3D 结构边缘与由轮廓、纹理和外观变化导致的视角相关图像边缘；仅用合成数据训练也能泛化到真实图像。
conclusion: CGGT 为从非约束视觉输入进行 CAD 风格线框重建提供了新方案，降低了对密集标定视图和逐场景优化的依赖；Wireframe-100K 也有望推动结构化曲线学习，并展现实际应用潜力。

title: NOVA-GS: Noise-Aware View-Consistent Gaussian Splatting for Low-Light Novel View Synthesis
abstract: Reconstructing 3D scenes under real-world low-light conditions remains challenging due to severe sensor noise, low signal-to-noise ratios, and degraded photometric consistency, which destabilize geometry estimation and novel view synthesis. Existing approaches often rely on well-lit reference data for reliable Structure-from-Motion (SfM) initialization under degraded inputs or apply per-view enhancement methods that introduce cross-view inconsistencies. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{NOVA-GS}, a unified noise-aware framework for low-light 3D Gaussian Splatting that subsumes enhancement, denoising, and geometry optimization within a single process. Our method leverages VGGT-based feed-forward estimation to obtain robust camera poses and geometry directly from degraded inputs, eliminating the need for SfM. Building on this initialization, NOVA-GS integrates three coupled components: a structure-aware enhancement module for exposure correction, a self-supervised denoising module with blind-spot masking for pseudo-supervision, and a consistency-driven Gaussian Splatting optimization enforcing cross-view geometric coherence. We further introduce a noise-guided spherical harmonic regularization to suppress view-dependent artifacts in noisy regions. Extensive experiments on diverse real-world low-light datasets demonstrate improved geometric fidelity, color consistency, and robustness without requiring paired supervision or well-lit references. this https URL
tldr: 提出噪声感知且跨视角一致的3DGS框架NOVA-GS，在低光噪声输入下统一增强、去噪与几何优化。
motivation: 真实低光场景存在严重传感器噪声、低信噪比和光度一致性退化，导致几何估计与新视角合成不稳定。现有方法依赖良好光照参考进行SfM初始化，或采用逐视角增强而引入跨视角不一致。
method: NOVA-GS利用VGGT前馈估计从退化输入直接获得鲁棒相机位姿与几何，无需SfM。它将结构感知曝光校正、基于盲点掩码的自监督去噪伪监督、以及一致性驱动的3DGS优化耦合起来，并引入噪声引导球谐正则抑制噪声区域的视角相关伪影。
result: 在多种真实低光数据集上，方法提升了几何保真度、颜色一致性与鲁棒性，且无需配对监督或良好光照参考；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: NOVA-GS将增强、去噪与几何优化统一到单个低光3DGS流程，降低对SfM、配对监督和良好光照参考的依赖，为真实低光新视角合成提供更稳健的方案。

title: KAD-Net: Kinematics-Aware Decoupled Learning for Robust 3D Hand Pose Estimation from a Single Depth Image
abstract: Due to the complexity of hand kinematics and self-occlusion, existing 3D hand pose estimation methods based on single depth images struggle to comprehensively model the topological dependencies among hand joints. Furthermore, traditional hierarchical multitask architectures enforce a shared feature space for both 2D joint localization and depth estimation, which can induce mutual interference. To address these challenges, we propose a Kinematics-Aware Decoupled Learning Network (KAD-Net) for robust 3D hand pose estimation. Specifically, we first design a Finger Topology Constraint (FTC) module to enhance the representation of distal joints. This module utilizes three consecutive finger joints to construct a local kinematic representation to impose topological constraints, which supplements the kinematic features of the distal joints. The FTC module leverages the structural context from visible joints to assist in locating occluded distal joints, thereby improving robustness to occlusion. Additionally, we propose a task-decoupled hierarchical multitask framework. This framework separates 2D joint localization from depth estimation and incorporates a dedicated multitask learning strategy for depth regression, effectively isolating the UV and depth features to mitigate mutual interference and negative transfer. Extensive experiments demonstrate that KAD-Net outperforms existing methods on several benchmark datasets (ICVL, NYU, and MSRA), achieving state-of-the-art accuracy in 3D hand pose estimation. Potential applications of KAD-Net include human-computer interaction, virtual reality and gesture-based control systems.
tldr: 提出KAD-Net，通过手指拓扑约束与任务解耦多任务学习，提升单深度图3D手部姿态估计的精度与遮挡鲁棒性。
motivation: 现有单深度图3D手部姿态估计方法因手部运动学复杂和自遮挡，难以全面建模手部关节间的拓扑依赖；传统分层多任务架构还让2D关节定位与深度估计共享特征空间，易产生相互干扰。
method: KAD-Net首先设计Finger Topology Constraint (FTC)模块，利用三个连续手指关节构建局部运动学表示并施加拓扑约束，以补充远端关节的运动学特征，并借助可见关节的结构上下文定位被遮挡的远端关节。同时提出任务解耦的分层多任务框架，将2D关节定位与深度估计分离，并采用专用的深度回归多任务学习策略，隔离UV与深度特征，从而减轻相互干扰和负迁移。
result: 在ICVL、NYU和MSRA等基准数据集上的大量实验表明，KAD-Net优于现有方法，取得了3D手部姿态估计的最先进精度；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: KAD-Net为单深度图3D手部姿态估计提供了一种运动学感知与任务解耦的鲁棒方案，可应用于人机交互、虚拟现实和基于手势的控制系统。

title: VS-Splat: Voxel-Selective feed-forward Gaussian Splatting for end-to-end 3D object reconstruction from sparse-views
abstract: Feed-forward Gaussian splatting models have demonstrated remarkable effectiveness in reconstructing three-dimensional (3D) objects from a few two-dimensional (2D) images, even if they are unseen. As existing methods typically predict Gaussian primitives uniformly across the 3D space, most primitives are placed in non-object regions. This may hinder the representation of fine object details. This paper proposes a Voxel-Selective Gaussian Splatting model (VS-Splat), a new end-to-endfeed-forward Gaussian splatting framework that predicts many primitives only within selected voxels that are likely to belong to an object, without 3D structural supervision. To achieve this, we propose a new learnable voxel selection approach that identifies object-centric voxels only with 2D rendering supervision. Our sparse-view rendering experiments with three benchmark datasets show that proposed VS-Splat outperforms several state-of-the-art methods. We further demonstrate its effectiveness as a backbone for an existing densification method and show that anoptional extension improves its robustness to inaccurate camera pose estimates.
tldr: VS-Splat通过可学习体素选择，仅在物体相关体素内预测高斯图元，提升稀疏视图三维重建。
motivation: 现有前馈高斯泼溅方法通常在整个三维空间均匀预测高斯图元，导致大量图元落在非物体区域，从而限制物体细节表示。该工作旨在稀疏视图下实现端到端物体中心的三维重建，且不依赖三维结构监督。
method: 提出VS-Splat前馈高斯泼溅框架，引入可学习体素选择策略，仅利用二维渲染监督识别可能属于物体的体素，并在这些选定体素内预测大量高斯图元。该方法支持端到端训练，并可作为现有致密化方法的骨干。
result: 在三个基准数据集上的稀疏视图渲染实验表明，VS-Splat优于多种当前最优方法，并验证其作为现有致密化方法骨干的有效性；可选扩展还提升了对不准确相机位姿估计的鲁棒性。
conclusion: 该工作证明仅凭二维渲染监督即可学习物体中心体素选择，将高斯图元集中到物体区域，从而改善稀疏视图三维物体重建。其为前馈高斯泼溅提供了新框架，并可与致密化方法及位姿鲁棒性扩展结合，具有潜在应用价值。

title: Is Gaussian Splatting Becoming Neural Again? A Taxonomy and Controlled Study of Learned Parameterization
abstract: Three-dimensional Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) combines explicit primitives with efficient rasterization, yet recent systems increasingly use neural networks to generate or share Gaussian parameters. We characterize this trend along five axes: attribute decoding, spatial sharing, view-conditioned decoding, topology generation, and amortized inference. An analysis of 19 representative methods shows that these choices address different limitations and cannot be reduced to a binary neural label. We also isolate three forms of neural parameterization in a controlled mip-NeRF 360 study. Sharing appearance and opacity improves reconstruction quality, while decoding geometric structure offers no further gain. The evidence favors selective neuralization: shared functions help when they capture reusable correlations without sacrificing the local geometric freedom of explicit splats.
tldr: 本文对3DGS的神经参数化趋势进行五轴分类，并通过受控实验表明选择性神经化优于全面神经化。
motivation: 3DGS结合显式图元与高效光栅化，但近期系统日益使用神经网络生成或共享高斯参数；本文旨在厘清该趋势，并说明不同神经化选择针对的局限不能简化为二元的神经/非神经标签。
method: 本文沿五个轴（属性解码、空间共享、视角条件解码、拓扑生成与摊销推理）对19种代表性方法进行归纳分析，并在mip-NeRF 360上开展受控实验，分离三种神经参数化形式。
result: 在mip-NeRF 360受控实验中，共享外观与不透明度可提升重建质量，而解码几何结构没有进一步增益；19种方法分析表明各神经化选择应对不同局限。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 证据支持选择性神经化：当共享函数能捕获可复用相关性且不牺牲显式splat的局部几何自由度时，神经化才有益；该分类与受控结论可为后续3DGS系统设计提供指导。

title: 3D Point Splatting for mmWave Radar Novel View Synthesis
abstract: Solving novel view synthesis (NVS) for millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar requires a renderer that is physically faithful, complex-valued, and multi-viewpoint-tractable. No prior method achieves these three properties simultaneously. Differentiable Monte Carlo (MC) ray tracers implement the radar forward model directly with explicit material modeling and complex outputs, but do not scale to the multi-view optimization NVS demands. Optical-NVS ports of NeRF, hash grids, and 3D Gaussians train fast but discard phase and replace explicit material modeling with opaque learned features, restricting them to power-only range-azimuth (RA) magnitudes. We propose 3D Point Splatting (3DPS), the first differentiable point renderer for radar, derived directly from the standard solid-angle form of the radar equation. Each oriented 3D point carries an ITU-R P.2040 material model, evaluated in closed form, with the resulting complex phasor splatted into range bins through a precomputed point spread function (PSF). The complex-valued output makes the renderer product-agnostic. The same optimized scene yields analog-to-digital converter (ADC), complex range profile (CRP), and RA outputs through standard fast Fourier transform (FFT) pipelines without retraining for each format. On six outdoor ColoRadar scenes, 3DPS reaches 0.587 mean Pearson correlation on held-out RA images. This is between 1.7x and 5.2x the three optical-NVS baselines (RadarSplat, Radar Fields, DART). Training takes approximately 3 minutes per scene on a single RTX 4090.
tldr: 提出3DPS，首个基于雷达方程的可微点泼溅雷达渲染器，实现复数输出与多视角新视图合成，在ColoRadar上达0.587相关性。
motivation: 毫米波雷达新视图合成需要同时具备物理忠实、复数输出和多视角可优化的渲染器；现有可微蒙特卡洛射线追踪虽物理直接且输出复数，却难以扩展到多视角优化，而NeRF、哈希网格和3D高斯等光学NVS移植方法训练快但丢弃相位并依赖不透明学习特征，仅能生成功率域距离-方位幅度。
method: 提出3DPS，首个由雷达方程立体角形式直接推导的可微点渲染器；每个有向3D点携带ITU-R P.2040材质模型并闭式求值，所得复相量通过预计算PSF泼溅到距离bin。复数输出使渲染器与产品格式无关，同一优化场景经标准FFT流水线可生成ADC、CRP和RA，无需针对每种格式重训练。
result: 在六个室外ColoRadar场景的留出RA图像上，3DPS取得0.587的平均Pearson相关系数，为RadarSplat、Radar Fields和DART三个光学NVS基线的1.7倍至5.2倍；单张RTX 4090上每场景训练约3分钟。
conclusion: 3DPS首次将可微点泼溅引入雷达新视图合成，在物理忠实性、复数建模与多视角可扩展性之间取得统一，并支持多种雷达数据产品输出，有望推动高效雷达仿真与感知研究。

title: BridgeMatch: Conditional Transport Bridges in Matching Matrix Space for 3D Deformable Registration
abstract: Reliable non-rigid point cloud correspondences are important for deformable anatomical registration, embodied perception and manipulation, and dynamic 3D reconstruction. Coarse-to-fine methods reduce computational cost by selecting the top-\(K\) coarse regions. However, this pruning may remove weak but correct hypotheses and restrict fine matching to an incomplete search space. We present \paper, a two-stage generative solver that maintains the complete soft matching matrix at both coarse and high resolutions. Stage~I uses denoising diffusion to estimate a global matching matrix in the compact coarse-resolution space. We then lift this matrix to high resolution while preserving its hierarchy. The lifted matrix is rank-bounded and block-constant. Stage~II refines it through a conditional transport bridge. We implement the bridge with two types of dynamics: a deterministic endpoint-parameterized conditional Flow Matching (CFM) ODE and a stochastic Brownian-bridge SDE inspired by Schrödinger bridges. Both variants share the lifted source, a time-conditioned transformer, and a matching-matrix endpoint predictor. Experiments on 4DMatch and 4DLoMatch show that both variants produce more accurate correspondences than the compared methods and improve downstream registration, with larger gains in low-overlap cases. They also improve cross-dataset generalization on CAPE and DeepDeform without target-domain adaptation while using the same deformation solver.
tldr: BridgeMatch 通过两阶段生成式条件传输桥在完整匹配矩阵空间中实现3D可变形配准。
motivation: 可靠的非刚性点云对应对可变形解剖配准、具身感知与操作以及动态3D重建至关重要。现有粗到细方法用top-K粗区域剪枝降低计算量，但可能删除弱而正确的假设，并将细匹配限制在不完整搜索空间中。
method: BridgeMatch是两阶段生成求解器，在粗分辨率和高分辨率均保持完整软匹配矩阵。阶段I用去噪扩散在紧凑粗空间估计全局匹配矩阵，再按层次上采样为秩受限、块常数的提升矩阵；阶段II通过条件传输桥精化，实现为端到端参数化条件流匹配CFM ODE和受Schrödinger桥启发的随机布朗桥SDE两种动力学，二者共享提升源、时间条件transformer和匹配矩阵端点预测器。
result: 摘要未提供具体数值指标；在4DMatch和4DLoMatch上，两种变体均比对比方法产生更准确的对应并改进下游配准，低重叠场景增益更大。在CAPE和DeepDeform上，无需目标域适应且使用相同变形求解器即可提升跨数据集泛化。
conclusion: BridgeMatch表明，保留完整软匹配矩阵并以条件传输桥进行生成式精化，可避免粗剪枝造成的信息损失，为3D可变形配准提供有效方案并展现跨数据集泛化潜力。

title: Hologram Representation via Quadratic Phase Gaussian Splatting
abstract: We introduce Complex-Valued Quadratic Phase Gaussian (CVQPG), a novel hologram representation method that replaces standard 2D Gaussian representations used in 2D Gaussian Splatting with 2D quadratic phase functions. CVQPG incorporates additional learnable parameters to control the curvature of these bases. We evaluate our approach against state-of-the-art methods, exceeding the visual quality by +0.19 dB (RGB) and +0.33 dB (grayscale) on average in holographic reconstructions. Specifically, our equal parameter count evaluations show that modulating the primitive's wavefront is an effective and lightweight enhancement for hologram representations. In addition, our frequency domain analysis illustrates that CVQPG has successfully preserved the mid-to-high frequency band of natural images.
tldr: 提出CVQPG，以二维二次相位函数替代2D高斯表示，提升全息重建质量并保留中高频信息。
motivation: 现有2D Gaussian Splatting使用标准2D高斯基元，难以有效刻画全息重建所需的复杂波前与相位特性。该工作旨在通过改进基元表示来提升全息图的重建视觉质量。
method: 提出复值二次相位高斯CVQPG，将2D Gaussian Splatting中的2D高斯基元替换为2D二次相位函数，并引入可学习参数控制这些基元的曲率，从而调制基元波前。
result: 与最先进方法相比，全息重建平均视觉质量在RGB上提升+0.19 dB、灰度上提升+0.33 dB；等参数量实验表明波前调制是有效且轻量的增强方式，频域分析显示CVQPG成功保留了自然图像的中高频段。
conclusion: CVQPG证明通过二次相位调制基元波前可在不增加参数量的情况下提升全息表示质量，并保留中高频细节，为全息图表示与计算全息提供轻量有效的改进方向。

title: Predictive Multi-Landmark OCT Tracking for Increased Motion Robustness
abstract: Optical coherence tomography is a promising modality for markerless motion tracking due to its high spatial resolution and inherent depth perception. However, existing OCT-based tracking approaches are limited in terms of trackable velocity, particularly when multiple landmarks are tracked sequentially for 6D pose estimation. In this work, we present a predictive tracking approach that propagates positional updates between multiple tracked landmarks to obtain a global pose prediction. This enables more robust tracking under high velocities. Our results demonstrate RMSEs below 1 mm for velocities up to 100 mm/s and up to nine consecutively tracked landmarks, highlighting the potential of global motion propagation and prediction for improving the robustness of OCT-based tracking.
tldr: 提出预测式多标志点OCT跟踪，通过全局位姿预测提升高速运动下的6D跟踪鲁棒性。
motivation: OCT具备高空间分辨率和深度感知，适合无标记运动跟踪，但现有方法在顺序跟踪多个标志点进行6D位姿估计时可跟踪速度受限。
method: 提出预测式跟踪方法，在多个被跟踪标志点之间传播位置更新，以生成全局位姿预测，从而在高速度下实现更鲁棒的跟踪。
result: 实验表明，在速度高达100 mm/s、最多连续跟踪9个标志点时，RMSE低于1 mm。
conclusion: 全局运动传播与预测能提升OCT跟踪鲁棒性，展现了高速无标记6D运动跟踪的潜力。

title: Tri-DehazeGS: Scene--Medium Decoupled Gaussian Splatting with Transmittance-Aware Optimization
abstract: Recovering clean 3D scenes from hazy multi-view images is challenging because haze attenuates scene radiance and introduces atmospheric scattering. Recent scattering-aware Gaussian Splatting methods introduce physical haze models into reconstruction, but they often apply degradation in image space or bind medium-related variables to Gaussian primitives, which can entangle clean scene radiance with atmospheric effects. Moreover, low-transmittance regions provide weakened supervision for Gaussian optimization, causing distant or dense-haze areas to be under-reconstructed. We argue that clean reconstruction under haze requires both scene--medium disentanglement and transmittance-aware optimization rebalancing. To this end, we propose Tri-DehazeGS, a scene--medium decoupled Gaussian Splatting framework. It represents the clean scene with Gaussian primitives, models the participating medium using an independent view-shared tri-plane field, and composes hazy observations through a physical scattering model. We further introduce Medium-Decoupled Transmittance Gradient Compensation (MD-TGC), which compensates haze-suppressed gradients after medium freezing without altering forward rendering. Experiments on real and synthetic haze benchmarks show that Tri-DehazeGS improves clean novel-view reconstruction. Code is available at https://github.com/aptx46/Tri-DehazeGS.
tldr: 提出场景-介质解耦的3D高斯泼溅框架Tri-DehazeGS，通过独立三平面介质场与透射率感知梯度补偿提升雾天干净新视角重建。
motivation: 雾霾会衰减场景辐射并引入大气散射，现有散射感知3DGS方法在图像空间施加退化或将介质变量绑定到高斯基元，导致干净场景辐射与大气效应纠缠；同时低透射率区域监督较弱，使远处或浓雾区域重建不足。
method: Tri-DehazeGS用高斯基元表示干净场景，用独立且跨视角共享的三平面场建模参与介质，并通过物理散射模型合成雾天观测；进一步提出MD-TGC，在冻结介质后补偿被雾霾抑制的梯度且不改变前向渲染。
result: 在真实与合成雾霾基准上的实验表明，Tri-DehazeGS提升了干净新视角重建效果，摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作表明雾霾下干净重建需同时实现场景-介质解耦与透射率感知优化重平衡，为散射感知3DGS提供了新框架，代码已开源。
